function solve!(out::Vector{Float64}, x::Vector{Float64})
    n = length(x)
    if n == 0
        return out
    elseif n == 1
        out[1] = x[1]
        return out
    elseif n == 2
        out[1] = x[1]
        out[2] = x[2]
        return out
    end
    
    # Check if out and x might alias to ensure we read original values correctly
    if Base.mightalias(out, x)
        # Create a copy of x to use as source data
        src = copy(x)
    else
        src = x
    end
    
    for i in 2:n-1
        out[i] = (src[i-1] + src[i] + src[i+1]) / 3.0
    end
    
    # Endpoints remain unchanged
    out[1] = src[1]
    out[n] = src[n]
    
    return out
end
